newsitem.title: USA: Fairchild stake raised by Cramer group.
newsitem.headline: Fairchild stake raised by Cramer group.

text.p: A group led by New York investor James Cramer said Wednesday it raised its stake in Fairchild Corp to 1,248,300 Class A common shares, or 9.0 percent, from 7.6 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 183,300 Class A common shares between March 20 and May 1 at prices ranging from $11.75 to $13.48 per share.
Fairchild, based in Chantilly, Va., manufactures industrial mechanical components and systems.
